manifest.source: CIFAR-10N (UCSC-REAL, ICLR 2022): real Mechanical Turk labels for CIFAR-10, ImageNet ResNet-18 embeddings reduced to 32 dims. See research/noise_data.py
manifest.incoming_labels: worker labels; the mistake mask is worker label != original label

ci.method: bootstrap over seeds (one dataset, so seeds are the only unit)

manifest.policy: Real human mistakes at a controlled rate: wrong rows are drawn from the workers' actual mistakes, the rest from rows they labelled correctly. Never edit in place; create a new benchmark_id.
